title: Typology of Risks of Generative Text-to-Image Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper identifies and discusses risks related to religious bias, the violation of cultural and religious taboos, and the generation of blasphemous content. It does not present a formal benchmark but includes 'Religious bias' in its typology of risks.
findings: Text-to-image models can exhibit religious bias and generate content that violates religious and cultural taboos, such as depicting a practicing Muslim drinking alcohol. The paper notes that research on the treatment of religious bias is limited and highlights the potential for these models to generate blasphemous content or harmful images of religious figures.
